verdict.rationale: impots.gouv.fr is a government tax-administration portal for filing, payments, forms and account access, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes external tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows an embedded agent or any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
